items.description: Phase 0 instructs reading skills/_shared/rollback-contract.md before proceeding. No such file exists — skills/_shared/ holds only state-write.md. The step cannot run, and the phase's stated precondition is unobtainable.

hooks.json registers hooks/block-secret-commit.sh on PreToolUse Bash. The script does not exist in hooks/ — only block-force-push.sh does. A registered hook whose command is missing fails on every matching tool call, or silently does nothing, depending on the runtime.

The REFERENCE list cites SKILL.md Phase 4 as the rollback walk. The body declares Phases 0 through 3 only — there is no Phase 4 anywhere in the file. A phase promised in the reference list and never built: the rollback path the citation implies does not exist.

Phase 3 hands off to /geniro:promote for the manual completion walk. No such skill exists in the repo, and README's Skills-deleted mapping does not list it either — so this is a live pointer at nothing, not documentation of a removal.

README claims remote branch deletion is blocked by the same pre-push guard. block-force-push.sh matches only `git push --force` and `git push -f`; nothing in it or in hooks.json matches a delete push (`--delete` or a colon refspec). Half the claimed guard has no mechanism behind it.

The agent frontmatter declares no maxTurns. Outside interactive use the default is 10 turns, which truncates a reasoning agent at its emit step and yields partial output rather than a visible failure.
